India Condemns Pakistan Airstrikes in Afghanistan; Tensions Rise

Pakistan conducted airstrikes in Afghanistan over the weekend, resulting in civilian casualties. India has officially condemned these actions, highlighting concerns over the loss of life. The strikes have also led to increased border tensions between Pakistan and Afghanistan, with the Taliban labeling the action as barbaric. The situation raises questions about regional stability and Pakistan's role.
